answer: Keys are cheap; long-haul fiber is not. Map each payout address to one dark-fiber strand and drop a second claim on that ID. The strand is identified by its OTDR kernel, the splice-reflection fingerprint recorded at install all the way to a tundra landing. After the seed posts, that thread of glass has one short window to return a signed trace that includes the seed and matches the fingerprint. One strand cannot attest two fingerprints in that window, so every extra identity needs another lease. Assumed cost, not a quote: about $90 a month, so 110 clones run about $9,900 monthly.
